subtitle: A place for your team to write, with Claude on it
description:
A writing platform for teams. Sign in, pick your name, and start a workspace for your team at its own address, such as /lumen. Invite the people who write with a single-use link. Each writer has a page there, like /lumen/@maya, and can keep personas: other names to write and comment under, which readers can't link back to them. One person can be in many workspaces.

Any post can have a drawn cover instead of a photo: an isometric line drawing in the workspace's style, on paper, in a flat colour or in bold blocks, that moves under your pointer. Point at a day and it lifts out of the calendar; move across a battery and the sun crosses the sky while it charges.

Readers comment the way they would in a book's margin: select any passage, add a note, and it stays highlighted for everyone, with the conversation beside it. Or respond to the whole post. Anyone signed in comments on any workspace, under the name they pick, and each workspace decides whether comments from outside its team wait for approval. Claps go up to fifty a person.

The editor is block-based like Notion, posts are Markdown underneath, and every page is rendered on the server, so it reads without JavaScript and search engines see it all. Themes are a few HTML templates and a stylesheet; each workspace picks one. Connect Claude and it can draft and publish posts as you, answer ordinary comments in your voice and leave anything sensitive for you.
whatsNew: A pass over the details: headings wrap evenly, footer links are easier to tap, invites say how long they have left, comment times show the day, Claude's connector address is readable on a phone, post previews skip raw formulae, and the sample teams wear their own colours.
